company.name: ZETA SURGICAL
company.shortDescription: ZETA SURGICAL is a medical technology company developing AI-powered surgical navigation and robotics for precise neurosurgical procedures.
company.description: Zeta Surgical is redefining the standard of care for image-guided surgery. Its cutting-edge navigation and robotics platform applies advanced AI to enable high-accuracy image guidance across any point-of-care in minutes, unlocking a new era of less invasive and more effective targeted therapies. The Zeta Navigation System and the Zeta TMS Navigation System are cleared by the FDA and commercially available in the US.

aiResearchSummary.text: Zeta Surgical is engaged in developing systems and methods for controlling and navigating robots in surgical environments, focusing on techniques to adjust the location of surgical robots in response to patient movement, as described in Robotic surgical control and navigation. Additionally, they are working on systems for tracking and aligning surgical instruments with configurable displays, as detailed in Systems and methods for handheld real-time surgical navigation guidance. These efforts address surgical navigation and robotic control.
